Sphere Tracing Basics | ronja-tutorials/ShaderTutorials | DeepWiki
Feb 26, 2026Sphere tracing (a form of ray marching) renders geometry by shooting a ray through each pixel and repeatedly querying a Signed Distance Function (SDF). The SDF returns the distance to the nearest surface at any given point.
